name: Brutish Guide (Scout Archetype)
body:
Some scouts are closer to barbarians in demeanor, using great strength and intimidation to contend with wild places.

Rage (Ex)

Brutish guides can tap into an inner fervor, gaining rage at 1st level as the barbarian ability of the same name. While raging the brutish guide gains a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution and a +2 morale bonus to Will saves and a -2 penalty to Armor Class. This increase in Constitution grants additional hit points per Hit Dice and, unlike a barbarian, these hit points are lost first like temporary hit points.

Entering a rage is a free action which costs 1 grit point to activate and a brutish guide can rage for one minute or until the brutish guide chooses to end their rage.

The brutish guide can also end their rage as a free action, losing all of its benefits and becoming fatigued for a number of rounds equal to twice the number of rounds they spent raging.

This ability replaces the trapfinding ability normally gained at first level as well as one deed of the brutish guide’s choice normally available at 1st level.

Rage Powers (Ex or Su)

At 2nd level, the brutish guide gains a rage power, using their scout level as their barbarian level. They gain an additional rage power at 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th levels.

The brutish guide does not gain the adrenaline rush class feature at 2nd or 14th level and does not gain a bonus combat feat at 6th or 18th levels.

Indomitable Spirit (Ex)

Brutish guides can press on even in the face of exhaustion and desperation. At 8th level, they may spend 2 grit points to enter a rage while fatigued. This suppresses the fatigued condition while the rage lasts, though afterwards the brutish guide becomes exhausted instead. This ability replaces the adrenaline rush ability normally gained at 8th level.

Greater Rage (Ex)

At 12th level, the brutish guide’s fury grows. Rage now grants a +6 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution and a +3 morale bonus on Will saves. This replaces the combat feat normally gained at 12th level.

Mighty Rage (Ex)

At 20th level, the brutish guide’s rage is nearly unstoppable now granting a +8 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution and a +4 morale bonus on Will saves. This ability replaces the adrenaline rush ability normally gained at 20th level.
